findings.F1: In the falling agitated profile, high-close days (close in the top quarter of the range) fall more the wider the day's range is against its last 20 days, step by step. The mean unusual next-day move is +0.40 % below 0.7 times the usual range (110 cases), -0.68 % at 0.7–1 (90), -1.57 % at 1–1.5 (45, t -1.86), -2.41 % at 1.5–2.2 (28, t -2.90) and -2.22 % above 2.2 (8). The fade is graded across the whole range of widths, not only above the plan's 1.5 cutoff.
findings.F2: The book failed on activity, not on edge. It was in a position on 1 % of coin-days and made 0.005 trades a day against the 0.01 required. Its total move per case is 9.7 times the 0.19 % cost of a trade. Widening the situation, not the size per trade, is what the book lacks.
findings.F3: In the profile, a close in the upper half of the range fades about as much as one in the top quarter: -0.74 % at 0.5–0.75 (306 cases, t -2.24) and -0.63 % at 0.75–1 (319, t -2.08). Up days that close in the upper half fall -0.95 % the next day (449 cases, 198 days, day-clustered t -2.16). How near the high the close sits adds no grading beyond the upper half.
findings.F4: The effect lives in the profile. Outside it, high closes in falling-but-calm markets move -0.34 % the next day (t -0.85), and in rising markets they move +0.48 % (t 1.37). Inside the profile they move -0.63 %. This fits the brief's claim that only a downtrend with high agitation fades strong closes.
findings.F5: The fade on up days in the profile held in 2018, 2019 and 2020 (-1.74 %, -1.37 % and -0.81 %, with t -1.87, -2.38 and -1.03). It reversed in 2021 (+0.62 %, t 0.51), and the tested cases rose in 2021 as well (4 cases, +3.36 %). It points the same way on 5 of 6 coins, XRP excepted.
findings.F6: In the same profile, low closes rebound +1.51 % the next day (322 cases, t 4.17), and the two lowest quintiles of scaled one-day return rebound +1.92 % and +1.37 % (t 4.74 and 3.77). This is the falling agitated long rebound the profile map already holds 12 times, so it is not a discovery.

ideas.idea: In a falling, agitated market, a coin that closes in the upper half of its day's high-low range falls over the next day, and the wider that day's range is against its ranges of the last 20 days, the larger the fall.
ideas.consequence: A trader fades every strong close in an agitated downtrend, sizing up with the day's width instead of waiting for only the rare very wide days, which gives the short book several times more trades at the same cost per trade.
ideas.name: graded width high close fade
